template: The original C64 pose masks were centered in a 4 by 2 grid of 32 by 32 cells and magnified 12 times with nearest-neighbor sampling. Use the build script's --guide-dir option to reproduce the reference images.

studies.prompt: EDIT the supplied 4-column × 2-row sprite template. It is an enlargement of a real 128 × 64 pixel sprite sheet. Treat it like a tiny indexed bitmap displayed at 1200% nearest-neighbor zoom. Each square logical pixel is a single flat ink: roughly 12×12 output pixels per one input pixel. Preserve the EXACT 8 occupied silhouettes, bounding boxes, facing, and cell centers. Repaint their interiors only. They must look deliberately CHUNKY, crude and pixelated, as if someone drew on graph paper with a fat square marker; 16×21 logical pixels per standing body! The face fits in 5×5 dots, an eye slit is a short bar. Limit a body to 4 or 5 solid colors with one readable connected patch for each material; one rectangular accent at most per limb. Hard stair-step edges, no gradients, no intermediate shades, no grain, NO dithering, no outlines inside outlines, no single-dot all-over decorations. No resized high-resolution illustration. Think actual early coin-op coin-slot arcade sprite data with strongly readable hand-placed clusters. Existing solid background is only a mask guide; deliver transparent outside each figure, no labels, no grid, retain regular atlas layout. All poses fit safely within their original cells. Stocky GREEN sumo, Yamo. Large mid-green belly and head (#669933), a SINGLE attached yellow-green highlight (#BBDD77) across the lit cheek/shoulder, dark ink near-black hair/topknot and lower shadow (#111111), a simple two-pixel tall continuous pale mawashi belt (#99BBCC). A black brow on the front of the head. Keep a great deal of solid green. In the seated fall pose the head remains high; underline the waist on the belly, not the face. Broad silhouette. No tiny abs or scales.

Guard has the straight vertical staff on the LEFT behind his head; the bottom-left lunge has the staff extended to the RIGHT. Only paint the existing projections. No extra stick or new limbs. Distinct hood, upper arm, boot, easy to read on a blue wall.
